newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berentzen 1996 profit down, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Berentzen 1996 profit down, sales up.

text.p: German wine and spirits maker Berentzen Gruppe said on Tuesday that its net profit without minority interests fell to 32.1 million marks in 1996 versus 33.1 million marks previously.

The company said its sales for the same period were up 22 percent on the previous year at 561.3 million marks, while profit according to DVFA accounting rules was up 14 percent at 29.1 million marks from 25.5 million in the year before.
Berentzen also said its profit per share for 1996 was up 14 percent, but gave no direct figures.
It said the discrepency between the DVFA profit and net profit figures was due to a 4.9 million marks in extraordinary income booked in 1995.
"The development of the group was, overall, slowed down by a weakening business course during the fourth quarter," the group said in a statement.
Berentzen said that in the first quarter of this year, sales including spirits tax were up five percent at 265.2 million marks. Excluding the tax, sales were down nine percent at 124.8 million marks.
It said it expected 1997 results to be affected by the development of new products during the course of the year.
